name: Cihuela (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and blue, the white hoist charged with the crowned arms of Cihuela (a fleur-de-lis and the bars of Aragon, with the motto VIGILANTE EN LA FRONTERA), the blue fly with three yellow stars in the upper part.
history: Municipal flag of Cihuela; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
